title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineering Manager (m/w/d)
description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As Senior Security Operations Engineering Manager (m/w/d) located in Germany, you grow NVISO's Security Operations Engineering (SOE) business and lead its senior delivery capability. You are responsible for commercial growth, delivery performance and functional management of the experienced SOE population.

SOE delivers consultancy projects for strategic customers in defense, energy, space, finance, retail and other industries. Our work covers SOC management, SOC design, SIEM and detection engineering, SOC automation and vulnerability management. You have a strong SOC background, but your main focus is to win work, grow customers and help teams deliver it well.

You report to the Solution Lead for Security Operations Engineering and work closely with the CEN Service Line Lead and partners.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Owning the SOE revenue target and sales pipeline, covering new business, expansion of existing accounts and follow-on work;
  • Building customer relationships and leading proposals, SOWs, RFP responses and tenders, with partners approving final commercial commitments;
  • Working with team leaders to manage delivery quality, customer satisfaction, staffing, utilisation, profitability and delivery risk;
  • Acting as a senior escalation point for complex customer and delivery matters, and contributing to selected high-end projects;
  • Providing functional leadership to team leaders and SOE consultants with six or more years of relevant experience in their SOC field of expertise;
  • Coaching experienced consultants and contributing to performance, career, staffing, development, retention and recruitment decisions;
  • Bringing customer and delivery feedback to the Solution Lead to support the development of the SOE portfolio.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;
  • At least eight years of experience in cyber security, with a strong foundation in security operations, SOC consulting or a closely related field;
  • At least three years of experience in business development, sales, account management or a commercially oriented consulting role;
  • Demonstrable experience growing cyber-security services through new business, customer expansion and long-term account development;
  • Experience shaping and delivering complex professional-services engagements, including proposals, SOWs, RFP responses or tenders;
  • Strong understanding of SOC operating models, SOC management, SIEM engineering and detection engineering;
  • Experience managing consulting delivery, including customer expectations, quality, staffing, utilisation, profitability and delivery risk;
  • Experience leading, coaching or functionally managing experienced cyber-security professionals and/or team leaders;
  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in the relevant local language(s).

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;
  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 90.000 p.a. – 130.000 EUR p.a.;
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;
  • 30 holidays;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

title: Manager Finance & Operations (m/w/d)
description:
München (präferiert) oder Remote in Voll- oder Teilzeit

Du sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere Zahlen im Griff haben – und baust mit uns die Strukturen für unser weiteres Wachstum.

Edtelligent entwickelt Software- und Datenlösungen für die berufliche Weiterbildung. Wir unterstützen bereits über 100 Bildungsträger dabei, ihre Angebote effizient zu verwalten und mehr Menschen zu erreichen. Mit GenauMeinKurs bauen wir außerdem eine Plattform, die Menschen hilft, die Weiterbildung zu finden, die wirklich zu ihnen passt.

Mit rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen wachsen auch unsere internen Abläufe. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die Finance und People Operations zuverlässig zusammenhält, Prozesse verbessert und der Geschäftsführung den Rücken freihält. Dabei hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege und wirst im Tagesgeschäft von einer Werkstudentin oder einem Werkstudenten unterstützt.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Gründer- und Führungsteam zusammen, das langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung digitaler Plattformen mitbringt. Bei uns verbindest du Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, von einem erfahrenen, sympathischen und outcome-orientierten Team zu lernen.

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn du starke Finance-Skills mitbringst, strukturiert arbeitest und Lust auf Organisationsentwicklung sowie ein breites Aufgabenfeld hast.

Aufgaben

  • Finance & Planung: Du entwickelst unsere Finanz- und Businessplanung weiter, erstellst Budgets und Forecasts und behältst Liquidität, Kosten und die wichtigsten Geschäftskennzahlen im Blick.
  • Controlling: Du bereitest Zahlen so auf, dass wir Entwicklungen früh erkennen und gute Entscheidungen treffen können. Du gehst Abweichungen auf den Grund und leitest gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung nächste Schritte ab.
  • Rechnungen, Abschlüsse & Forderungen: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen korrekt und pünktlich erstellt werden, Zahlungen nachverfolgt und offene Forderungen konsequent bearbeitet werden. Auch Eingangsrechnungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatung laufen bei dir zusammen.
  • HR-Prozesse: Du sorgst dafür, dass vom Arbeitsvertrag über Onboarding und Personaladministration bis zum Offboarding alles sauber organisiert ist. Du koordinierst die vorbereitenden Abläufe für die Gehaltsabrechnung und bist für das Team eine verlässliche Ansprechperson bei administrativen Fragen.
  • Legal & Verträge: Du behältst wichtige Vertrags- und Unternehmensthemen im Blick, pflegst Unterlagen und Fristen und koordinierst bei Bedarf die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberater:innen.
  • Operations: Du erkennst, wo Abläufe unnötig kompliziert oder fehleranfällig sind, und machst sie einfacher und verlässlicher. Dabei setzt du digitale Tools und Automatisierung dort ein, wo sie uns wirklich helfen.

Du musst nicht jede dieser Aufgaben bereits gemacht haben. Wichtig ist, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, dich zügig in neue Themen einarbeitest und dafür sorgst, dass Dinge zuverlässig erledigt werden.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast etwa 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt, zum Beispiel im Finance, Accounting oder Controlling eines Digital- oder Wachstumsunternehmens, in einer Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
  • Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und hast Lust, Prozesse mit AI und Automatisierung einfacher und effizienter zu machen.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Finanzzahlen und verstehst sowohl das laufende Rechnungswesen als auch die vorausschauende Planung eines Unternehmens.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und sorgfältig. Du behältst Fristen, Details und offene Punkte im Blick, ohne dich darin zu verlieren.
  • Du hast Freude daran, unterschiedliche Themen zu koordinieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und gute Prozesse aufzubauen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich – mit Kolleg:innen ebenso wie mit Steuerberatung, Rechtsberatung und anderen externen Partnern.
  • Du packst selbst mit an und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass Dinge nicht nur geplant, sondern auch umgesetzt werden.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Personio, HubSpot, DATEV, ChatGPT, Claude (Code), Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht der konkrete Toolstack, sondern dass du dich schnell in neue Systeme einarbeitest und Lust hast, sie aktiv zu nutzen.

Besonders gut passt du zu uns, wenn du Finance beherrschst, dich aber nicht auf Finance beschränken möchtest.

Benefits

  • 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an.
  • 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Gründer- und Führungsteam und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • 🏡 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub und die Wahl zwischen unserem Büro in München-Giesing und Remote Work.
  • 🌱 Ein herzliches, ambitioniertes Team mit offener Kommunikation.
  • 📈 Die Möglichkeit, die internen Strukturen eines wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmens maßgeblich mitzugestalten.
  • 🛠️ Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir digitale Tools und KI selbstverständlich nutzen.
  • 🎯 Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Wir wollen Menschen den Zugang zu passender beruflicher Weiterbildung erleichtern.

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil. Wir freuen uns besonders zu erfahren, welche Prozesse du schon verantwortet oder verbessert hast – und warum dich eine breite Rolle zwischen Finance, HR und Operations reizt.

title: Staff Cyber Security (w/m/d)
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Als Cyber Security Engineer (m/w/d) spielst Du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Sicherheit unserer Anwendungen und Systeme. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifizierung von Sicherheitsrisiken, die Durchführung von Sicherheitsbewertungen und die Entwicklung von Sicherheitslösungen, die unsere Betriebs- und Entwicklungsteams bei der Umsetzung von resilienteren und robusteren Anwendungen unterstützen. Diese Position bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, an herausfordernden Projekten zu arbeiten und mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Best Practices im Bereich der Cyber- und Informationssicherheit zu implementieren.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams zur Integration von Sicherheitskontrollen und -maßnahmen in den Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus und in sichere Betriebsabläufe
  • Durchführung von Sicherheitsbewertungen, wie Penetrationstests, Bedrohungsmodellierungen und Konzeptüberprüfungen
  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von technischen Sicherheitstools zur Sicherstellung zentraler Sicherheitskontrollen wie Schwachstellenmanagement oder die Einhaltung von Vorschriften bei selbstverwalteten Arbeitsstationen
  • Planung und Durchführung gezielter Schulungen zu Anwendungs- und Infrastruktur-Sicherheit

Qualifikationen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich der Informationssicherheit und intrinsische Motivation, Dein Wissen ständig aktuell zu halten
  • Verständnis für moderne, agile Produktentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung mit DevSecOps-Konzepten
  • Erfahrung mit technischen Sicherheitsprüfungen aller Art (White-Box und Black-Box), idealerweise in regulierten und zertifizierten Umgebungen wie KRITIS, PCI-DSS
  • Sicherer Umgang mit mindestens einer Programmiersprache, idealerweise Python und/oder Java, sowie Erfahrung mit modernen virtuellen Maschinen und Container-Umgebungen
  • Teamplayer durch und durch, der stets mit gutem Beispiel vorangeht. Du fühlst Dich wohl dabei, Projekte und Stakeholder auch in stressigen Situationen effizient zu führen
  • Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, gute Englischkenntnisse, Qualitätsbewusstsein, Eigenverantwortung und die Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Team zu arbeiten

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Corporate Development Manager - Strategy, Finance & AI Operations (m/f/d)
description:
Building the Distribution Infrastructure for Private Markets

Privatize is headquartered at the Marienturm in Frankfurt am Main. We connect private banks, wealth managers, family offices and insurers with leading global Private Markets managers such as BlackRock, Carlyle, J.P. Morgan and Ares. Our technology serves as the "Home for Private Markets" and is used by advisors, portfolio managers and product managers in their daily client business.

Aufgaben

Objective of the Role

You have spent your first years in strategy consulting, investment banking, M&A advisory or venture capital and now want to move from supporting decisions to shaping them?

As Corporate Development Manager, you work directly with our leadership team on the topics that drive Privatize forward: strategic projects, commercial models with our partners and the financial steering of the company. You take ownership from day one and see the impact of your work immediately.

Part of the role is to build our finance and operations backbone. We do this AI-first: your job is to set up processes once, cleanly and automated.

Your Responsibilities

Strategy & Commercial

  • Drive strategic projects together with the leadership team, from analysis to decision paper
  • Develop and evaluate commercial models and pricing for partnerships with asset managers and wealth institutions
  • Conduct market, competitor and business case analyses to identify growth opportunities
  • Prepare materials for management, shareholders and other internal and external stakeholders

Finance & Steering

  • Own and further develop our financial model, including budgets, forecasts and liquidity planning
  • Define, track and interpret KPIs and derive concrete recommendations for management
  • Build dashboards and reportings for data-driven decision-making

AI-first Operations

  • Design and automate our finance and administrative processes using AI tools and modern software
  • Support monthly and annual closings in collaboration with our external accounting
  • Ensure the quality of our data basis and continuously improve internal processes

Qualifikation

What We Are Looking For

  • Degree in business, finance, economics or a related field
  • 1-3 years of professional experience in M&A, investment banking, strategy consulting, transaction services, venture capital or a comparable environment
  • Strong analytical skills, structured thinking and solid financial modelling in Excel / Google Sheets
  • Ability to condense complex topics into clear recommendations and presentations
  • Hands-on mentality: you take ownership of operational topics as well – and find ways to automate them
  • Strong interest in AI tools and their practical use in day-to-day work
  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken

Benefits

What You Can Expect from Us

  • Direct collaboration with the leadership team and exposure to all key decisions
  • Real ownership and a broad scope across strategy, finance and operations
  • The opportunity to build a modern, AI-first finance and operations function from the ground up
  • A growing company in the Private Markets ecosystem, working with renowned asset managers and wealth institutions

About Privatize

At Privatize, innovation and financial expertise come together to shape how Private Markets are distributed to wealth clients. We offer a professional, supportive environment with flat hierarchies, room for personal development and the opportunity to make a real impact.

description:
uNaice ist Pionier im Bereich der automatisierten Contentproduktion und automatisierten Datenaufbereitung und -anreicherung.

Wir entwickeln Kunden, die sich an der Schwelle zur Digitalisierung befinden. Unsere Kunden sind u.A. Und das in 110 Sprachen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen engagierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Verwaltung, der unsere Kunden von Geschäftsanbahnung bis Customer Success mit den relevanten Verwaltungsaufgaben begleitet.

Dein Anschreiben wünschen wir uns in deutscher Sprache.

Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

Aufgaben

uNaice wächst und mit uns auch die Anforderungen in der Verwaltung und Administration. Hervorragende Prozesse und Organisation in der Verwaltung sind eine entscheidende Grundlage für fehlerfreies Wachstum. Unsere Prozesse und Abläufe sind in einem Wiki und in div. Video-Tutorials sauber dokumentiert, daher ist ein erfolgreiches Onboarding vom Start gewährleistet.

  • Administratives Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb und Produktion mit Kontakt zum Kunden. Du übernimmst das verwaltungstechnische Onboarding unserer Kunden und die reibungslose Übergabe in die Produktion

Qualifikation

Du hast idealerweise eine fundierte, kaufmännische Ausbildung, Studium ist nicht Pflicht, möglicherweise jedoch schön für deine weiteren Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der uNaice.

Du bist absolut fit im Umgang mit dem Internet, arbeitest mit Chrome und kennst Firefox und Explorer nur aus Erzählungen. Die GSuite ist dir auch näher als Office365.

Du kannst eine Bilanz richtig rum halten und dir ist klar wo in der GuV die relevanten Zahlen stehen. Du beherrschst den Unterschied zwischen Handelsspanne und Rohertrag und kannst Kalkulationen mit einem einfachen Dreisatz schnell plausibilisieren.

Du bist zuverlässig, schnell, extrem lernwillig und lernfähig, zäh in der Auseinandersetzung mit neuen Herausforderungen und Aufgaben.
Du hinterfragst auch gerne mal Prozesse und denkst mit, denn Weiterentwicklung ist für dich ein must have.

Du sprichst Englisch perfekt und schreibst fehlerfrei.

Perspektivisch hast du große Lust dich fortzubilden, zu lernen, zu wachsen und auch neue und zusätzliche Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

Dich prägt eine AI first Arbeitsethik und Methodik. Vom ersten Tag an automatisierst du deine low-hanging-fruit Aufgaben weg, damit dein Weg frei wird für mehr Fachkompetenz.

Benefits

  • Remote arbeiten zu 100%
  • regelmäßige Präsenztreffen mindestens einmal pro Jahr
  • unregelmäßige Präsenztreffen quartärlich in Teamkonstellation in Abhängkeit von Projekten
  • Karrieremöglichkeiten: Nach Betriebszugehörigkeit von mindestens einem Jahr und zweimaliger A-Bewertung, ist der Weg frei für eine vierstufige Fachkarriere-Entwicklung (E4-E1)

Wir arbeiten ausschliesslich remote. Unsere Mitarbeiter*innen sind verteilt von Brisbane, Australien bis Lissabon, Portugal. Die Mehrheit unseres Teams sitzt an unterschiedlichen Orten in Deutschland.

Remote bedeutet nicht unprofessionell. Wir setzen einen geeigneten Arbeitsraum voraus. Arbeiten "von der Bettkante" ist nicht unser Ding. Wir stellen alle erforderlichen Arbeitswerkzeuge gegebenenfalls zur Verfügung wie jeder "normale" Arbeitgeber auch.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & Full-Funnel Growth - 100% remote
description:
Wir sind eine stark wachsende Direct-to-Consumer-Marke im Gesundheitsbereich und verkaufen hochwertige Supplements direkt an unsere Kund:innen. Unsere wichtigste Wachstumsmaschine: Direct-Response-Marketing über Meta Ads.

Ein hoher ROAS ist für uns kein Ziel – meistens ist er ein Zeichen dafür, dass zu wenig ausgegeben wird. Wir steuern auf Wachstum: Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und ein CAC, der sich am Kundenwert misst. Wenn du ohnehin in Deckungsbeiträgen und CAC/CLV denkst statt in Plattformkennzahlen, ist das hier dein Standard. Wenn nicht, ist es die falsche Stelle.

Wir suchen jemanden, der den kompletten Funnel von der Ad über das Offer und die Landingpage bis zum Kauf als ein System versteht, systematisch testet und Budget dorthin bringt, wo es profitables Wachstum erzeugt – auch wenn das auf Plattformebene erstmal unbequem aussieht.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Media Buying auf Wachstum steuern: Du verantwortest unsere Paid-Social-Konten eigenständig – Budget, Kampagnensetup, Adsets, Creatives einbuchen. Du skalierst, solange die Unit Economics tragen, und skalierst nicht, um Plattformmetriken zu schonen.
  • Full-Funnel-Diagnose: Du analysierst regelmäßig den gesamten Weg von Ad über Offer und Landingpage bis zur Conversion, findest den größten Engpass und priorisierst genau dort.
  • Creative Testing & Creative Diversity: Du entwickelst Testhypothesen, bewertest Creative-Performance und sorgst dafür, dass das Konto nicht von zwei Winning Ads abhängt: verschiedene Angles, Formate, Creator und Hooks parallel im Test, damit Skalierung nicht an Creative Fatigue scheitert. Learnings gehen konkret und datenbasiert an Creative Strategist und Copywriting zurück.
  • Offer- und Landingpage-Tests koordinieren: Du priorisierst den Test-Backlog für Bundles, Preislogik, Value Stack, Message-Match und Landingpage-Struktur, briefst die Fachteams, wertest aus und rollst Gewinner aus.
  • Steuerung nach Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit: Deine Entscheidungsgrundlage sind Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und CAC im Verhältnis zum Kundenwert – nicht der ROAS einer einzelnen Kampagne.
  • Attribution & Datenqualität: Du liest Performance nicht aus dem Ads Manager, sondern aus unserem Attributionsmodell. Du weißt, wo Plattform-Attribution und Realität auseinanderlaufen, sorgst für saubere Datenerfassung und klärst Auffälligkeiten früh mit IT.
  • Struktur & Reporting: Einheitliche Naming Convention, nachvollziehbare Account-Struktur, feste Reporting- und Review-Routinen für Wachstum, Budget und Learnings.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying für Meta Ads im D2C-Kontext – du hast eigenverantwortlich Budgets gesteuert und ein Konto profitabel wachsen lassen, nicht nur effizient gehalten.
  • Du kannst erklären, warum ein Konto mit ROAS 1,0 und wachsendem Neukundenstamm mehr wert ist als eines mit ROAS 4 und stagnierendem Umsatz – und du hast das schon einmal jemandem erklären müssen.
  • Du denkst in Funnels und Kohorten: Du weißt, dass ein schlechter Neukunden-CAC auch am Offer oder an der Landingpage liegen kann, und dass der Wert eines Neukunden erst nach dem ersten Kauf entsteht.
  • Testgetrieben: Du setzt Tests mit klarer Hypothese, Erfolgskriterium und Auswertungslogik auf und dokumentierst, was du lernst.
  • Sicher in Datenanalyse und Attribution – du hast mit Attributionstools jenseits des Ads Managers gearbeitet, kennst die Grenzen von Plattform-Attribution und Tracking-Setups (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs) und erkennst, wenn Daten nicht stimmen.
  • Du kennst gängige DR-Mechaniken (Hook–Problem–Solution, Value Stack, Social Proof, Scarcity) und kannst beurteilen, warum ein Creative oder Offer performt.
  • Du weißt, dass Creative Diversity kein Kreativ-Nice-to-have ist, sondern die Voraussetzung dafür, dass ein Konto skaliert – und planst deinen Testing-Mix entsprechend.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Creative-, Copy- und Web-Teams zusammen – als Taktgeber mit klaren Briefings, nicht als Einzelkämpfer.
  • AI-Tools für Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung und Creative-Analyse nutzt du bereits
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Supplement- oder Health-Brands.

🛠 So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Du bekommst volle Verantwortung für die Paid-Social-Konten und ein Team, das zusammen mit dir Creatives, Copy, Landingpages und Tracking bearbeitet – du priorisierst, was gerade am Wichtigsten ist.
  • Du steuerst mit denselben Zahlen wie die Geschäftsführung: CM3, aMER, MER, Neukunden, Kundenwert. Kein separates „Marketing-Dashboard", das schöner aussieht als die Realität.
  • Wir arbeiten mit Notion für Prozesse, Slack fürs Team und einem eigenen Attributionsstack, in den wir laufend investieren – du steuerst nach diesen Zahlen, nicht nach Meta's Zahlen.
  • Rollen sind bei uns klar definiert: Objective, Job Results, KPIs. Du weißt, wofür du verantwortlich bist – und was nicht.
  • Entscheidungen fallen auf Basis von Daten. Wenn die Daten fehlen, holen wir sie, bevor wir raten.

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine Marke mit klarer Positionierung und Produkten, perfekt für unsere Zielgruppe – und eine Organisation, die Paid Social als Wachstumsmotor denkt, nicht als Kostenstelle.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, echtes Mandat über Budget und Testing.
  • Regelmäßige Performance-Reviews und Learnings – wir skalieren, was funktioniert, und dokumentieren, warum.
  • Remote-Only mit klaren Prozessen und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Die Möglichkeit, das Performance-Marketing-System einer wachsenden Health-Brand von Grund auf mitzubauen – und mit ihr zu wachsen.

Let's grow it!

Du denkst in Full-Funnel, Neukunden, Deckungsbeiträgen und hast den den CLV im Blick?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei konkreten Beispielen, in denen du Meta Ads mit Direct Response Mechaniken zum Wachstum geführt hast und einem kurzen Statement, warum du in unser Team gehörst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

description:
Du willst nicht nur Social Media managen, sondern selbst das Gesicht einer Marke werden?

BuddySIM macht mobiles Internet auf Reisen einfach. Mit unseren eSIMs können Reisende in über 190 Ländern direkt online gehen: 100% ohne Roaming-Stress, SIM-Kartenwechsel oder komplizierte Tarife.

Jetzt wollen wir unsere Marke auf Social Media auf das nächste Level bringen. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, vor der Kamera zu stehen, Menschen anzusprechen und gemeinsam mit uns Content zu entwickeln, der auffällt.

Du wirst eines der Gesichter von BuddySIM auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts und weiteren Plattformen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und repräsentierst BuddySIM auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Formate, Reels, TikToks und wiederkehrende Content-Serien.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und führst beispielsweise spontane Interviews, Straßenumfragen oder Reise-Challenges durch.

  • Du beobachtest Trends und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Sounds und Themen Potenzial haben.

  • Du entwickelst Ideen, Hooks, Storylines und Skripte.

  • Du produzierst authentischen Content von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Video.

  • Du begleitest Events, Reisen, Kooperationen oder Aktionen mit der Kamera.

  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine wiedererkennbare Social-Media-Persönlichkeit für BuddySIM auf.

  • Du analysierst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du managed Kooperationen mit anderen Creatoren:innen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Du bist kommunikativ, spontan und kannst Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen.

Außerdem wäre ideal, wenn du:

  • dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und authentisch auftreten kannst,

  • offen und selbstbewusst auf fremde Menschen zugehst,

  • TikTok, Instagram und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends wirklich verstehst,

  • ein gutes Gespür für Humor, Storytelling und interessante Hooks hast,

  • kreative Ideen nicht nur vorschlägst, sondern auch direkt umsetzen möchtest,

  • eigenständig arbeiten und Verantwortung für eigene Formate übernehmen kannst,

  • grundlegende Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt mitbringst,

  • Lust auf Reisen und internationale Themen hast,

  • sehr gutes Deutsch sprichst; Englisch ist ein Plus.

Ein klassischer Lebenslauf oder ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns deutlich weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und dein Gefühl für Social Media.

Was dich bei BuddySIM erwartet

BuddySIM ist ein wachsendes Travel-Tech-Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Wir wollen keine austauschbare Corporate-Kommunikation produzieren, sondern Social Media machen, das Menschen tatsächlich anschauen möchten.

Bei uns bekommst du:

  • sehr viel kreativen Freiraum,

  • die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate von Grund auf aufzubauen,

  • kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung,

  • direkten Austausch mit dem Gründerteam,

  • moderne Tools und Equipment für deine Content-Produktion,

  • ein junges, dynamisches Umfeld,

  • die Möglichkeit, bei Reisen, Events und besonderen Aktionen dabei zu sein,

  • und vor allem die Chance, eine sichtbare Persönlichkeit unserer Marke zu werden.

Wer perfekt zu uns passt

Vielleicht produzierst du bereits selbst TikToks oder Reels.

Vielleicht bist du die Person in deinem Freundeskreis, die problemlos mit jedem ins Gespräch kommt.

Vielleicht hast du bisher noch nie professionell Social Media gemacht, weißt aber ganz genau, warum manche Videos Millionen Views bekommen und andere niemanden interessieren.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Interesse?

Dann schick uns keinen Roman.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und gerne direkt ein kurzes Video, in dem du dich vorstellst.

Bonus: Schick uns eine Idee für ein TikTok oder Reel, das du für BuddySIM drehen würdest.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

IHRE AUFGABEN

  • Sicherstellung der vertragskonformen Erbringung von Facility-Management-Dienstleistungen innerhalb eines definierten Kundenportfolios beziehungsweise einer zugewiesenen Region

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen auf unterschiedlichen Entscheidungs- und Hierarchieebenen sowie aktive Unterstützung der strategischen Kundenentwicklung
  • Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung der zugeordneten Mitarbeitenden
  • Bedarfsgerechte Ressourcen- und Einsatzplanung sowie Förderung einer leistungsorientierten, kollaborativen und kundenfokussierten Teamkultur

Qualifikation

IHR PROFIL

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Facility Management, Gebäudetechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Alternativ eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Meister- oder Technikerausbildung beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Facility Management, technischen Gebäudemanagement oder einem vergleichbaren dienstleistungsorientierten Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie in der Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden und interdisziplinären Teams
  • Ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Budgets, Forecasts und betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen
  • Hohe Organisations- und Planungskompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert zu bearbeiten und klare Prioritäten zu setzen
  • Analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise in Verbindung mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenz auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchie- und Entscheidungsebenen
  • Gute Kenntnisse relevanter Arbeitssicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von QHSE-Prozessen im operativen Umfeld
  • Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in dynamischen Situationen souverän zu agieren
  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung mit einem ausgeprägten Verständnis für langfristige und vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

UNSER ANGEBOT: WAS SIE VON UNS ERWARTEN KÖNNEN

  • Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Unternehmen und einem dynamisch wachsenden Marktumfeld
  • Vielfältige fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten einschließlich hochwertiger Weiterbildungsprogramme und international anerkannter Zertifizierungen
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket mit Zuschüssen zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, Prämien für erfolgreiche Mitarbeiterempfehlungen sowie umfangreichen Corporate Benefits
  • Zusätzliche Benefits wie JobRad, Deutschlandticket und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte bei zahlreichen Partnerunternehmen
  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Kalenderjahr
  • Umfassende Angebote im Bereich Gesundheit und Prävention, beispielsweise arbeitsmedizinische Vorsorge, Impfangebote und Zuschüsse für Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrillen
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem globalen Unternehmensumfeld mit vielfältigen fachlichen und länderübergreifenden Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem anspruchsvollen Aufgabengebiet mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Unternehmenskultur, die von Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit, Arbeitssicherheit, gegenseitigem Respekt und einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance geprägt ist

AUSGEZEICHNETER ARBEITGEBER

Die Qualität unserer Unternehmenskultur, unserer Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und unseres Arbeitsumfelds wird regelmäßig durch nationale und internationale Auszeichnungen bestätigt. Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Best Workplace for Women 2026, LATINA Style

title: Vice President (m/f/d) Equity Rebalancing
description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Job Overview

Are you passionate about capital markets, index investing, and client-facing investment solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, international environment? We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial markets and quantitative investment strategies with excellent communication and relationship-management skills, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients and stakeholders across global markets.

Your Tasks

  • Manage and oversee a diverse portfolio of quantitative equity indices, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all rebalancing activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the underlying investment strategies and client objectives.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for an international client base, including leading investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and trading desks, acting as a trusted advisor on index methodologies, rebalancing outcomes, and quantitative investment strategies.
  • Lead and coordinate the resolution of client inquiries, escalations, and complex index-related issues, delivering clear, actionable guidance and ensuring a high standard of client service.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and service quality across index management and client support processes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data, Engineering, and Product, to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery and the successful implementation of client requirements.

Your Profile

  • Academic degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Mathematics, or Engineering.
  • At least 6 years of experience in equity markets execution, portfolio management, index management, or in a similar process-driven financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of equity markets, ETFs, index construction, or systematic investment strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership, able to operate independently and manage operational responsibility across multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to handle time-sensitive operational workflows.
  • Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset and intercultural competence.
  • Python skills are an asset.
  • Fluency in English.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience innovation and excellence in FinTech.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in a flat-hierarchy, startup-like environment.
  • Vacation & Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a market-competitive salary, job ticket, gym membership, and access to Corporate Benefits.
  • Employer Pension Contribution: Benefit from the occupational pension scheme (bAV).
  • Professional Development & Certifications: Grow personally and professionally, with support for certifications and training opportunities.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in networking and team engagement events.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a hybrid work model in a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.
You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.

Who We Want

7+ years of finance experience.
You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Closing and audit expertise.
You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements.

Expert financial modelling.
You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.

Forecasting.
You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

Business partner.
You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented.

Experience with investors and the board.
You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side.
Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities.

Appetite for automation.
You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly.

Strong communicator.
You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal.

Who We Don't Want

Manages the status quo.
You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further.

Reports instead of advising.
You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent.

description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Treasury is where Mollie's balance sheet takes shape, this team makes sure that our balance sheet is safe, well-funded and resilient. You, as Treasury Manager, will be one of the first people building the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function for Mollie.

This is a genuine 0-to-1 role. There is no legacy ALM framework to maintain, no existing ILAAP to update, no established models to inherit. You'll help design and build the liquidity risk framework, the interest rate and credit spread risk approach, and the funding and balance sheet strategy. Your work will feed directly into Mollie’s licence application and, once authorised, into how Mollie actually manages its liquidity and funding risks.

You'll work closely with our product teams, Finance, and Risk Domains and your analysis will be seen by senior leadership and, eventually, by our regulator. As Mollie moves from application to operation, your scope will grow from building the framework to running it.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own the core building blocks of Mollie liquidity risk framework, including the ILAAP, LCR/NSFR monitoring, and liquidity stress testing.

  • Develop Mollie’s approach to interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB), from risk identification through to models, limits and hedging strategy.

  • Contribute to the design of Mollie’s funding and balance sheet strategy, including deposit mix, funding diversification and balance sheet construction.

  • Build the Contingency Funding Plan and related early-warning indicators, so Mollie knows exactly what to do under stress before it needs to.

  • Produce clear, well-documented policies, methodologies and models that will stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors, and Mollie's own second and third lines of defense.

  • Support senior leadership (ALCO or its future equivalent) with the analysis, reporting and recommendations it needs to make sound balance sheet decisions.

  • Partner with Risk, Finance and our external advisors, to make sure Treasury's frameworks are consistent with Mollie’s wider risk appetite and governance.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant.

  • Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole.

  • Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one.

  • Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it.

  • The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

If you're excited by the idea of building a bank's Treasury function from scratch, for Mollie and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance and banking with us.

Tech Stack

 

At Bazaarvoice, we value strong engineering fundamentals over narrow technical specialisation. Curiosity and adaptability matter more than familiarity with any specific tool. However for context, here's the Managed Content team's current tech stack:

 

Backend/API: Java, 

Frontend/BFFE: React, Node js, TypeScript, Express

  • - You like to come up with a solution when you present a problem

  • - You solve engineering challenges not only for yourself, you look for repeatable patterns and implement solutions which impact your peers

  • - While you love independence, you care about working in a passionate team 

  • - Whenever you start a new piece of work, you ask yourself “What is the client trying to achieve?”

  • - You measure success based on the impact you have both on the client and your peers

  • - You care about your personal growth, and your peers’ personal growth

  • - You believe that knowing what the product should do is only for Product Managers

  • - Love your craft, but believe that there is no space for Agentic AI in software engineering

Stronger Together

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Data Engineer

Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property.

We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents.

We’re looking for someone to own that foundation.

The opportunity

You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have.

The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform.

There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable.

  • Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled.

  • Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data.

  • Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context. Preserve source provenance, geographic scope and effective dates so consumers can distinguish current information from historical or superseded guidance.

  • Design for international expansion. Build shared models and ingestion patterns that accommodate differences in property markets, tax systems and regulation. When we expand geographies, we want to go at speed, without rebuilding the platform.

  • Own reliability throughout the lifecycle. Build monitoring, validation and recovery into ingestion, transformation, storage and serving. Know what is stale, missing or incorrect, understand the customer impact and address the root cause.

  • Set the technical direction and deliver it. Make clear trade-offs between immediate product needs and long-term architecture. Ship useful improvements early, document decisions and help shape the standards and future team needed to support the platform.
